bio.text: John Elleson won the Republican primary for Illinois' 9th Congressional District on March 17, 2026.
His 2026 WTTW voter guide entry lists his occupation as minister and says he has never held a government office.

In 2018, a John D. Elleson, also a Republican primary candidate in Illinois' 9th District, told the Chicago Sun-Times he pastored a church in Arlington Heights; his 2018 questionnaire lists a pastoral theology degree from Christian Life College (1985).
